biography_sections.title: Three Johns and the Gairbraid source conflict
biography_sections.markdown: Hill’s inspected printed p. 53 distinguishes senior John Hutcheson in Gairbraid, husband of Marion Wilson or Jarden, from their eldest son John, husband of Agnes Anderson. The existing John profile mixes those generations; the attached father relationship to Thomas remains uncertain without a percentage. Hill reports the 19 November 1582 charter and names Thomas as the younger son. The eldest John or his son John apparently conveyed the property or reversion to George on 5 August 1600; the actor remains alternative. [Inspected printed page 53](https://archive.org/download/earlyrecordsofol00hill/page/n78.jpg). Underlying charters uninspected.
